title: On Reinforcing the weakened north wall
subtitle: 工程建造 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 工程建造（科学与技术·工程与建造）
meta: 主题语境：工程建造（科学与技术·工程与建造）　|　核心词汇：reinforce　|　正文 335 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 reinforce 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1973 the father ① reinforced the weakened north wall at once, and every neighbour in the house said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three months on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the father ② reinforces the weakened north wall in the rain without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ reinforce the weakened north wall at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ reinforced the weakened north wall before — a line in the letter for September 1967 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Reinforcing the weakened north wall at once, the father said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the chair at the far door, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ reinforce the argument with three examples in the rain, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Reinforce the argument with three examples at once and never mention it again.

By 1980 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the letter, and a new neighbour from the next house ⑧ reinforces the argument with three examples at once every month without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the door, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ reinforced the weakened north wall again when nobody else would.

⑩ To reinforce the weakened north wall, my mother said in 1985, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the house remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the house forgets, somebody reinforces the weakened north wall in the rain again and somebody must reinforce the weakened north wall at once all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 增援（一般过去式 reinforced the weakened north wall：1973 年父亲头一回这样做，二话不说地）
B. v. 增援（一般现在 reinforces the weakened north wall：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 增援（不定式 to reinforce the weakened north wall：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 增援（过去完成时 had reinforced the weakened north wall：1967 年九月的家书上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 增援（动名词 reinforcing the weakened north wall 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 加固（reinforce the argument with three examples：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去加固用三个例子把那番道理加固）
G. v. 加固（reinforce the argument with three examples：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 增援（后段两处：新来的邻居照例 reinforces the argument with three examples，而母亲又一次 reinforced the weakened north wall）

answers.why: reinforce 意为“增援”，1973 年父亲二话不说地增援把已经松动的北墙加固，那是老屋里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 reinforced。
reinforce 意为“增援”，自那以后父亲淋着雨把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 reinforces。
reinforce 意为“增援”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯增援把已经松动的北墙加固”，此处为不定式 to reinforce the weakened north wall。
reinforce 意为“增援”，家书里 九月 那行字说明早在 1980 年之前就有人增援过，故用过去完成时 had reinforced。
reinforce 意为“增援”，父亲说“增援把已经松动的北墙加固这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 reinforcing the weakened north wall 作主语。
reinforce 意为“加固”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去加固用三个例子把那番道理加固”，should ever 之后用原形 reinforce the argument with three examples。
reinforce 意为“加固”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻加固用三个例子把那番道理加固（reinforce the argument with three examples at once），以后再也不要提起。
reinforce 意为“增援”，新来的邻居每个月份都照例加固用三个例子把那番道理加固，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 reinforces。
reinforce 意为“增援”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次二话不说地增援把已经松动的北墙加固，用一般过去式 reinforced 叙述。
reinforce 意为“增援”，结尾那句是母亲 1985 年的话：要增援把已经松动的北墙加固，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和老屋记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 reinforce 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1973 the father reinforced the weakened north wall at once, and nobody in the house forgot it.
Even now the father reinforces the weakened north wall in the rain whenever the house asks.
Reinforcing the weakened north wall at once, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever reinforce the argument with three examples in the rain, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new neighbour from the next house reinforces the argument with three examples at once every month, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother reinforced the weakened north wall again, and the house remembered that half.
